name: quartermaster
description: Looks at your recent Claude Code sessions and asks what would make your goals easier to reach: a measurement nobody can run yet, work you keep doing by hand, knowledge you keep re-deriving, and the setup pushing back at you. A SessionEnd hook tallies each session locally (no LLM, no network); a retro skill mines the history and proposes one change at a time, each needing your approval; the next retro reports whether what you applied actually helped. Also sets up new projects from what your history shows you keep needing.
